TantumPay | Java Developer / Web & React Native Developer | Europe (CET) | Remote | Full Time

We're a FinTech company reinventing high-risk-market payments with an integrated digital identity layer. Our team is expanding, and we are looking for a Senior Java Backend Developer and a Senior Web/React Native Developer.

We are fully remote, and we are looking for someone in the same timezone.

Backend: https://tantumpay.com/en/jobs/senior-java-backend-developer

Frontend: https://tantumpay.com/en/jobs/mid-senior-web-react-native-de...
